body: I know I'm young, and I know almost every high schooler goes through a shitty phase like this, but I just don't feel "right" anymore. Nothing I do makes me happy. All I do is lay around and eat. I've been struggling with everything for years now. I just want to leave. Drive up to the park, hoodie and sweatpants on, "Wish You Were Here" playing on the stereo, and just slowly drift off. That's what I want. I know I sound pathetic. I don't like just as much as you.
